shorts.hook: In 1986, the internet got 1,000× slower in one afternoon.
shorts.spoken: In October 1986, the internet got a thousand times slower in one afternoon. Nobody had switched anything off.

shorts.hook: The fix for retrying has three words: double, cap, jitter.
shorts.spoken: The internet's fix for retrying is three words. Double, cap, jitter.

shorts.hook: Trying again is not always persistence. Sometimes it is a slower no.
shorts.spoken: Trying again is not always persistence. Sometimes it is just a slower no.
